reply_text:
I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, in the thread under Gideon's question.

The reply says Gideon first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in that channel. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836. Gideon confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

One thing to check before the postmortem: the SUP-5380 ticket note in the brain has an update logged at 08:12 on 3 Aug ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing"). That is earlier than the 10:42 channel report. I did not include it in the reply, because I could not tell from the note who wrote it or whether it was a report by Gideon.
